free_tier.stated: Verbatim: 'new-user trial: join the group, fill in the application form and immediately receive CNY 50 of compute credit, equivalent to 24 hours of a 4090' and 'deep support: after joining the group and submitting the form, individual developers who pass review receive from CNY 200 a month of ongoing compute support and up to CNY 1,500 in total compute resources'. Preferred profiles, any one of: a product with 10,000 monthly active users, a GitHub project with 100 or more stars, or technical content with 10,000 views or an account with 10,000 followers. Credit is issued as platform points and cannot be converted to cash.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: It chains with nothing at this size, and that is the reason to record it: CNY 50 buys about 24 hours of a single 4090, which is a smoke test and not a workload. It is the honest floor that shows how far the CNY 1,000,000 award sits from anything an individual obtains without a review.

limits.value: The no-threshold tier is only CNY 50, about 24 hours of one 4090; anything above that needs a review and, in practice, an existing audience or repository.

identity_cost.detail: no card and no identity document are stated; the gate is a manual review: the offer page says "join the group, fill in the application form and immediately receive CNY 50 of compute credit", and the larger tier needs joining the group and submitting the form plus a review that prefers a product with 10,000 monthly active users, a GitHub project with 100 or more stars, or content with 10,000 views. The record does not state what the account itself uses as an identifier, any hold, or debit or prepaid acceptance

evidence.proved: the CNY 50 trial and the up-to-CNY 1,500 tier with their conditions, quoted above; status 200 and live today.

published rate card so the credit converts to hours: RTX 4090 24 GB at CNY 15.84 for an 8-card hour, RTX 5090 32 GB at CNY 28.00, H20 96 GB at CNY 96.00. Credit is denominated in CNY and not hours, so the trial is about 24 hours of one 4090 on the vendor's own equivalence.

notes: NAME COLLISION, and it matters: Gongji and Qiji are different companies whose names transliterate similarly. Searches for one surface the other. Gongji is a commercial shared-compute marketplace selling 4090 and H20 time by the second; Qiji is the accelerator running the municipal compute grant. Do not merge these records. Answering the subsidiary question directly: MiraclePlus publishes no trial tier, no GPU-hour taster and no self-service allocation. The only zero-friction thing it offers is the right to submit an application. This plan is the nearest genuine no-review trial found in the same search space, and it belongs to a different vendor at roughly one two-thousandth of the Qiji ceiling.
